info.title: Confluence Cloud REST API (subset)
info.description: The two read operations the confluence profile uses, written from Atlassian's Confluence Cloud REST reference: CQL search (v1, which v2 has no replacement for) and reading a page (v2, body-format=storage gives the storage format, turned into text by the |storage converter). Not yet run against a live site.

get.summary: Searches for content using the Confluence Query Language (CQL).
